author: (Nowell-Usticke, 1959)

note.en: A small pisa snail of the Caribbean. WoRMS lists it for Costa Rica; the only record in the region box is a fossil-bed specimen, so it is only a record.
note.es: Un caracol pisánido pequeño del Caribe. WoRMS lo registra para Costa Rica; el único registro en la zona es de un depósito fósil, así que es solo un registro.

evidence: WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea
GBIF: 1 museum record in the region (Moín Formation material)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Only a fossil-bed specimen in the region.
